title: Broad Ribbon Seaweed Clump
description: One original static stylised broad ribbon seaweed clump: five unequal short basal stipes support five wide thick continuous undulating blades around one compact attachment hub. One closed connected editable body, with shared complete open-port boundaries between holdfast-shaped base, stipes and laminae. Five coherent constant opaque matte olive-brown PBR tones; no textures or alpha cards. Metres, native Z up, front -Y, attachment-centre origin and complete finite basal sole at Z=0. One reusable prop, zero scenes; blades, tones and formats are not separate assets. No prior plant geometry imported. Artistic seaweed-like form only; no exact species, botanical science, marine ecology, habitat, growth, fluid/current/wind simulation, animation, collision, navigation, physics or stability claim. No rock, seabed, water or scenery.
